name: sutando-life-provider
description: Expose bounded, read-only GitHub and Discord capabilities to Sutando Life through the local runtime.

inputs: Runtime capability reads for github.activity and discord.activity using their fixed read-only operations
outputs: Bounded JSON results with stable provider IDs, evidence URLs, cursors, and structured limitations or errors
guarantees: Uses the locally authenticated gh CLI without reading or returning its credential
Uses the local Discord bridge credential and access policy without returning or logging the token
Per invocation returns at most 100 identities, repositories, events, contexts, or messages
Performs read-only GitHub and Discord API operations
